intent: Presentational standalone OnPush stacked step cards (role=list, cards role=listitem tabindex=0, Enter/Space selects). Public API exactly: StepCardListComponent selector app-step-card-list { steps = input.required<readonly WorkoutStep[]>(); state = input<ViewState>('success'); selectedStepId = input<string | null>(null); showActions = input<boolean>(false); stepSelected = output<string>(); stepCompleted = output<string>() }. When showActions() is true each card shows a 'Mark step as completed' button emitting stepCompleted; completed cards show an inline check using app-icon (IconComponent selector app-icon { name = input.required<IconName>(); size = input<number>(24) }). Imports WorkoutStep, ViewState, IconComponent. Imported by dashboard and routines (shared per Rule 1 cond. 3).
